ext_data.CardText:
Strike, Slash, and Take Command with Strong Pokémon ex!
Adorn your collection with artistic flair in this special collection from the Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Shrouded Fable expansion! Inside is a special illustration rare–style promo card featuring one of two Pokémon ex, plus foil cards of their Evolution chain. And with the included Pokémon TCG booster packs, you’re sure to find even more awesome Pokémon for your next battle!

The Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Shrouded Fable Kingdra ex/Greninja ex Special Illustration Collection includes:
• 1 full-art foil promo card featuring Kingdra ex or Greninja ex
• 2 foil cards featuring either Horsea and Seadra, or Froakie and Frogadier
• 5 Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Shrouded Fable booster packs
• A code card for Pokémon TCG Live
